stem: Pest counts decline sharply after an intervention but rebound two weeks later in the same zone. What is the strongest next analysis?
choices: Assume the first count was wrong
Review the pest life cycle, untreated reservoirs or entry pathways, intervention timing, and follow-up monitoring rather than judging success from the initial decline alone
Stop recording counts once any decline occurs
Change the crop's nutrient program because rebound proves nutrient deficiency
rationale: A temporary reduction does not establish durable control. Rebound should prompt analysis of life cycle, sources, timing, coverage of the management plan, and continuing monitoring.
